overall: Council violated the Open Meeting Law by withholding executive session minutes on the Stigmatine property after the lawful purposes ended; the DEP-related session minutes may stay sealed until that matter is resolved.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleges the Council improperly withholds many sets of executive session minutes about the Stigmatine property taking, including Purpose 6 real-property sessions.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Open Meeting Law does not authorize the Council to continue to withhold from the public any minutes of executive sessions held under Purpose 6 related to the value of the Stigmatines property.

allegations.summary: Withheld minutes of Purpose 3 litigation-strategy sessions on the City's civil action against the Stigmatines after the settlement was approved.
allegations.key_passage: these executive sessions had concluded, since the Council no longer had a litigating position to protect.

allegations.summary: Council withholds minutes of a January 27, 2020 'anticipated litigation' session on a pending Department of Environmental Protection matter tied to the high school project.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that that the purpose for this executive session is still ongoing, and the Council may continue to withhold these minutes from public disclosure until such time as the matter before DEP is finally resolved.

allegations.summary: Not alleged in the complaint; the AG reminded the Council of its duty to timely create and approve minutes after finding some meetings documented only by stenographic transcripts.
allegations.key_passage: If the Council has any outstanding executive sessions for which minutes have not been created and approved, we order the Council to do so to the best of its ability within 60 days.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.

Identify and release to the public all executive session minutes identified in the determination, including Purpose 6 minutes from May 29, June 4, June 11, June 18, and June 25, 2018, and Purpose 3 minutes on the Stigmatine litigation, along with related documents and exhibits, within 60 days; review other potentially relevant sessions and release those too.
Create and approve any outstanding executive session minutes to the best of its ability within 60 days.
Notify the AG's office in writing of compliance with the order.
remedy_passage: We order the Council's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Council that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
